lines.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.
No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.
Every key from one to seven is taken, and room eight just got fresh paint.
Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!
Wait—let me look at the tablet screen and the paper ledger side by side.
Let me guess: you promised someone a room we do not have?
Manager Zhou! Room seven is already occupied, and you booked a second guest into room seven!
And he arrives here at eight o'clock this evening—in forty minutes!
Told you before, that tablet is a trap.
It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?
Wait—what is above the stairs on the third floor?
That sunny old attic study... follow me, quickly!
